objective.text: The focus of DAFT / DAFT-2 was to mitigate the risk for the Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment.
objective.quote: The focus of DAFT / DAFT-2 was to mitigate the risk for the Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment (SAME).

fuel.text: The fuel or material used was isopropyl alcohol.
fuel.quote: relies on gravity to recycle isopropyl alcohol used in the measurement process.

measurements.text: The modified P-Trak gathered data from counting aerosol particles.
measurements.quote: The modified P-Trak gathered data from counting aerosol particles and these data were compared to the DustTrak CNC specifically designed to work in microgravity.

earth_benefits.text: This research will impact the development of novel fire and smoke detection systems for the International Space Station and future spacecrafts.
earth_benefits.quote: This research will impact the development of novel fire and smoke detection systems for the International Space Station and future spacecrafts.
